name: code-orchestrator
description: Plan multi-phase repository work, then carry it out phase by phase with independent review and one final integration.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and deliver independently reviewed phases.
interface.longDescription: Two skills: turn a chosen direction into an implementation-ready phase plan, or carry out an existing plan with separate implementers, independent review of each phase, and one final integration. Both follow the repository's own rules and host policy.
defaultPrompt: Turn this approved design into a phased implementation plan.
Execute this phase plan through implementation, review, and final validation.
